sources.title: PSI Data Repository: Combustion Science
sources.use: The 26 investigations this dashboard is built on. Each is cited by its DOI.

sources.title: NASA Combustion Science
sources.use: Basic information about most of the combustion investigations in PSI.

sources.title: NASA ScienceCasts: The Power of Studying Combustion on the ISS
sources.use: A 3.6-minute introduction to combustion research on the ISS (2018).

sources.title: A Researcher's Guide to International Space Station Combustion Science
sources.use: A 2015 review of NASA's combustion research on, or planned for, the ISS.

sources.title: Apollo 1
sources.use: The 1967 fire in an oxygen-filled spacecraft during a pre-launch test, and the lessons learned.

sources.title: Apollo 13
sources.use: The oxygen tank explosion on the way to the Moon, the investigation and the lessons learned.

sources.title: 25 Years Ago: Fire Aboard Space Station Mir
sources.use: The 1997 fire on Mir caused by an oxygen generator failure.

sources.title: Fireman's Air Tanks
sources.use: 1970s spacesuit technology adapted to improve firefighters' air tanks and breathing gear.

sources.title: Fire Detector
sources.use: A 1970s smoke detector developed for the shuttle that tells smoke from dust, giving fewer nuisance alarms.

sources.title: New Technology for the Fire Attire
sources.use: 1980s spacesuit technology applied to improve firefighter clothing.
